summary: Join our Key Clauses in Commercial Contracts Training Course to gain vital insights into contract essentials and improve your business negotiations effectively.
lede: Key clauses in commercial contracts define obligations, payment terms, risk, and how changes or problems are handled. For professionals who review, negotiate, approve, or manage contracts, this course develops practical skills to assess scope and acceptance criteria, identify financial and liability risks, and manage changes, termination, and red flags.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals across sectors who regularly handle contracts or contract-driven relationships.
audience: Legal liaison officers and compliance staff
modules: Pricing, Payment Terms, and Financial Controls
Liability, Indemnities, and Limitation of Liability
Confidentiality, Data Protection, and Intellectual Property
Dispute Resolution, Governing Law, and Enforcement
Practical Contract Review Toolkit and Negotiation Playbook
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of business operations and prior exposure to contract management is beneficial but not required.
